answer: The zenith schedule is applied in oasis and fable publishes each instalment. A payout is split so that 51% arrives at settlement and the rest over 10 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. Someone therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2701 identities would post 2224 proofs and burn roughly 54 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
